name: glimmer
title: Glimmer
description: Stream apps from your paired PCs, wake a PC, and check your Glimmer stream from Raycast.
author: ugfuglio

commands.name: stream-app
commands.title: Stream App
commands.description: Browse apps on paired PCs and start or resume a Glimmer stream

commands.name: wake-pc
commands.title: Wake PC
commands.description: Wake a paired PC and wait for it to answer

commands.name: stop-streaming
commands.title: Stop Streaming
commands.description: Stop this Mac’s Glimmer stream using its disconnect setting, after confirmation

commands.name: glimmer-status
commands.title: Glimmer Status
commands.description: Show this Mac’s stream and video details in the menu bar
